bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to drivers' licenses; requiring the Department of Public Safety to offer road skills examinations for class D drivers' licenses in cities with populations greater than 70,000; appropriating money; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.13, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.13, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 8a.

Examination locations; cities over 70,000.

Notwithstanding existing locations where the department offers road skills examinations and the requirements under subdivision 1, paragraph (c), the commissioner must maintain and operate a road skills examination station in each city that has a population greater than 70,000 people as determined by the Minnesota State Demographic Center.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to examination stations opened on or after that date.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION.

$....... is appropriated from the driver and vehicle services operating account in the special revenue fund for the development and establishment of new road skills examination stations in the cities under the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 171.13, subdivision 8a. Funds appropriated under this section may not be used for existing road skills examination stations and must be used for:

(1) research, purchase, and development of suitable locations for road skills examinations in the cities of Blaine, Bloomington, Brooklyn Park, Lakeville, Maple Grove, and Woodbury; and

(2) operating costs to support testing at new driver's license examination stations operated under the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 171.13, subdivision 8a.
